pages.text: A full set of Bog Iron armor grants Unyielding: when a hit lands hard enough, the wearer gains extra armor, toughness, knockback resistance and attack damage for ten seconds and sends out a shockwave. It then needs thirty seconds to recover.$(br2)The helmet, chestplate and leggings pair Bog Iron with $(item)green wool$() for the cloth and $(item)leather$() for the straps and belts. Only the boots are pure iron.
